title: Veal and Rosemary Pie with Carrots
blurb: Tender veal and carrots braised with rosemary in a rich gravy, enclosed in golden puff pastry.
steps: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large casserole dish over medium-high heat, then brown the veal pieces on all sides and remove to a plate.
Add the onion to the pan and cook until softened, then stir in the flour and cook for one minute.
Pour in the beef stock gradually, stirring to avoid lumps, then return the veal to the pan with the carrots, rosemary, salt and pepper.
Bring to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook in a preheated oven at 160°C for 90 minutes until the veal is tender.
Remove from the oven, discard the rosemary stalks, and allow the filling to cool for 20 minutes.
Transfer the filling to a pie dish, then roll out the puff pastry and lay it over the top, trimming and crimping the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with beaten egg, cut a small steam hole in the centre, and bake at 200°C for 25 to 30 minutes until the pastry is puffed and golden.
